_comment: Text templates for dispatches the engine generates at runtime.
SIGINT: segments wrapped in [[double brackets]] may be redacted (shown as [REDACTED]). Placeholders:
SITREP / AAR bodies are composed by the combat engine; only sender/subject are templated here.

bodies:
HANDLING: EYES ONLY — {confidence} CONFIDENCE

Radio intercept on the Vosk {net} net ({freq} kHz) indicates [[{role_desc}]] of [[{unit_desc}]] relocating toward Sector [[{sector}]], approximately grid X:{x}, Y:{y}.

[[Fuel and rail allocations suggest movement within {eta} days.]] Traffic analysis only; the message content was only partially decrypted.

Grid references derived from direction-finding are accurate to several kilometres at best.

HANDLING: EYES ONLY — {confidence} CONFIDENCE

Direction-finding on a burst transmission from the {net} net ({freq} kHz) places [[{unit_desc}]] preparing to move. Decrypted fragment:

    "...[[{role_desc}]] TO CONCENTRATE AT X:{x} Y:{y} SECTOR [[{sector}]]... [[COMPLETE WITHIN {eta} DAYS]]..."

The fragment may be deliberate deception. Recommend corroboration by reconnaissance.

HANDLING: EYES ONLY — {confidence} CONFIDENCE

A spike in {net} net traffic ({freq} kHz), followed by radio silence, matches the pattern of a formation displacing. We assess [[{role_desc}]] moving toward Sector [[{sector}]], vicinity X:{x}, Y:{y}.

[[Unit identity: {unit_desc}.]] Estimated completion: [[{eta} days]].

clash.subject: CRITICAL: BORDER CLASH at Grid {x}-{y}
clash.body:
FLASH PRECEDENCE.

At first light this week, {friendly} ({friendly_designation}) made contact with {hostile_desc} at grid X:{x}, Y:{y} ({sector}).

Both formations are now ENGAGED and have halted. Small-arms and mortar fire is being exchanged along the contact line. Casualty reports are not yet available.

The engaged formations will not advance further while in contact. To break contact, issue a move order away from the enemy.

No reply required. Frontier Sector Command awaits the Lord Protector's intentions.

isolated.subject: URGENT: {designation} Isolated — Supply Line Cut
isolated.body:
IMMEDIATE.

The {unit} ({designation}) at grid X:{x}, Y:{y} ({sector}) can no longer be reached by any supply route. Enemy formations sit across every road and track back to our depots.

The formation holds {supply}% of its weekly needs in hand. When that is gone it will begin to starve: men will fall sick, desert and die, and it will not be able to advance.

Recommend immediate withdrawal toward our lines, or clearing the enemy from the supply route.

No reply required.
